source_references: Current Book of Dien Bien soft-3D atlas UI direction
prompt_summary: Create a new 941x1672 portrait tourist terrain diorama from the v4 atlas style reference. Keep the warm game-map illustration style, but show roughly twice the perceived geography: Dien Bien Phu basin and historic city cues in the lower/near layer, then hills, terraced fields, streams, small sparse hamlets and a waterfall on the right, fading into distant mountain ranges at the top horizon for very far Muong Nhe / A Pa Chai destinations. No UI, text, pins, labels, logos or watermark.

gps_projection.note: Runtime challenge pins still use deterministic GPS-derived grouping for the city atlas plus visual depth overrides for far western and hillside groups. Painted landmarks remain illustrative orientation cues, not navigation controls.

visual_depth_intent.foreground: Dien Bien Phu basin and city/historic core in the lower map area.
visual_depth_intent.midground: Valley-edge hills, terraced fields, waterfall, nearby hamlets and viewpoint terrain.
visual_depth_intent.background: Remote Muong Nhe / A Pa Chai journey markers placed near the distant mountain horizon.

transform: Generated PNG converted to 941x1672 lossy WebP at quality 86 with metadata stripped.
documentary_accuracy: Illustrative diorama only. Landmark forms and spacing are stylized; GPS challenge data remains the location source of truth.
